title: Counterfactual decision support for pre-trip electric vehicle charging: range estimation, state-of-charge-aware energy planning and rule-based advice (code and results)
description: Open-source repository providing a fully reproducible implementation of a pre-trip EV charging decision-support pipeline: nested group cross-validation of an EV range estimator, vehicle-specific efficiency and state-of-charge-aware energy requirement, charging plans at SAE J1772 / IEC 61851 power levels, physically constrained DiCE counterfactuals, and a trip-level evaluation on public datasets.
